question: Which of the following is a shortcut key to undo the last action in many word processors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + Z**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ctrl + Z** shortcut is widely used in many software applications, especially word processors, to **undo the last action**.
 
• This command is part of the **standard set of keyboard shortcuts** recognized by most operating systems and software.
 
• Using **Ctrl + Z** allows users to quickly revert mistakes or unwanted changes without having to manually correct them.
 
• This shortcut improves **efficiency** and **workflow** by saving time and effort.
 
• In addition to word processors, **Ctrl + Z** is also used in various other applications such as **graphics editors, spreadsheets, and coding environments**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ctrl + X**__

 __
 
• The **Ctrl + X** shortcut is used to **cut selected text or items** to the clipboard.
 
• It is often used in conjunction with **Ctrl + V** to move text or objects from one place to another.
 
 
 
• **Ctrl + C**__
 __
 
• The **Ctrl + C** command is used to **copy selected text or items** to the clipboard.
 
• Like **Ctrl + X**, it is commonly paired with **Ctrl + V** for pasting copied content.
 
 
 
• **Ctrl + V**__
 
 
• The **Ctrl + V** shortcut is used to **paste text or items** from the clipboard to the desired location.
 
• It is an essential part of the cut, copy, and paste operations in most software applications.
